exposure: oxytocin product (product of maximal infusion rate and total duration)
outcome: correlation with total oxytocin dose received in labor
cohort: 402 women from Duke and 6,907 women from Pithagore6 who received oxytocin during labor.
finding: The oxytocin product, calculated by multiplying the maximal oxytocin infusion rate by the total duration of infusion, showed a very high correlation with the total oxytocin dose received during labor.
